Name: delta_map_belief_updates
Title: Delta-Map Belief Updates for Stable Spatial Revision in Theory of Space
Short Hypothesis: Providing a VLM with an explicit prior cognitive map and enforcing incremental delta updates (preserve-unless-evidenced, overwrite-on-contradiction) reduces belief drift and false-belief inertia in the Theory of Space spatial reasoning benchmark compared to scratch regeneration.
Related Work: Theory of Space (ArXiv 2602.07055, Feb 2026) is a very recent benchmark evaluating VLMs on spatial reasoning under partial observability. It identified 'belief inertia' as a key failure mode but tested no interventions. Thinking in Space (CVPR 2025) explores cognitive maps for spatial reasoning. SpatialBench (Nov 2025) evaluates spatial understanding. No prior work tests incremental belief revision interventions on the ToS benchmark.

conditions: (B) Full regeneration with explicit update rules
notes: ALREADY uses Gemini API natively -- zero re-implementation needed
Existing results: +3.4% overall accuracy, +13.3% facing direction accuracy
First intervention study on ToS belief maintenance
